column3: Chapter 5, Protective Custody: Mendez truck standoff.
column4: While Jason and Lucia are still together, wait for Take Deal during the Mendez standoff in Protective Custody and accept. column3: Chapter 5, weak-relationship shoot route: tower exit.
column4: Enter the finale with a weak relationship and shoot Mendez. At the tower, Jason is shot while armed; as Lucia choose Stay Down. Jason dies and Lucia survives. This is the reported shoot route, not the deal route.\nAt the tower choose Stay Down (Square/X). Lucia takes the prosecutor’s deal; Jason dies. A weak-relationship save may be needed.

column3: Chapter 5, weak-relationship shoot route: tower exit.
column4: Enter the finale with a weak relationship and shoot Mendez. At the tower, choose Defend Jason rather than Stay Down. Both die according to current guides.\nDefend Jason (R2/RT) at the tower; both die. An older save with a weak relationship may be needed.

column3: Chapter 5, The End of the Road: bridge police blockade.
column4: Shoot Mendez and reach the bridge branch of The End of the Road. Choose No Surrender; both die. No additional savings or profile requirement is reported once at the bridge.\nNo Surrender is R2/RT at the bridge. The bridge route requires shooting Mendez while the relationship is intact.

column3: Chapter 5, bridge blockade and post-credits scenes.
column4: Reach the bridge after shooting Mendez and choose No Surrender with $2,000,000 in Family Savings. A family epilogue is reported after the fatal outcome; this is an epilogue variant, not a different survival result.\nThe savings epilogue changes the family home, not the fatal outcome.

column3: Chapter 5, The End of the Road: bridge police blockade.
column4: Reach the bridge after shooting Mendez. Choose Swim for It; with a violent Criminal Profile (Psycho or Irredeemable reported), let the Exit prompt expire. Jason emerges armed and both die. Check the actual profile and prompt in-game.\nSwim for It and Exit use Triangle/Y. Violent-profile route: let Exit time out. If Jason says not to draw a weapon, you are on the clean-profile route instead.

column3: Chapter 5, armed bridge exit and post-credits scene.
column4: Follow the armed Swim route and let Exit expire; with $2,000,000 in Family Savings, guides report an additional family epilogue despite the fatal result.\nSavings change the family epilogue, not the fatal result.

column3: Chapter 5, The End of the Road: bridge police blockade.
column4: Reach the bridge after shooting Mendez. With clean profiles, choose Swim for It and press Exit. Jason exits unarmed; Lucia escapes and Jason takes the fall. For the reunion variant, meet the separate savings and relationship requirements.\nRequire Hot Together and clean profiles, with less than $2,000,000 saved for the prison-only variant. Press Exit (Triangle/Y). The final prison visit distinguishes this from the reunion.

Before the finale: Hot Together, both Criminal Profiles Professional, and $2,000,000 in BuckMe Family Savings. Shoot Mendez, choose Swim for It at the bridge and press Exit. The reported reunion occurs two years later.\nAfter the bridge arrest, the later scene shows Jason released and the family reunited. The guide reports a $2.5M on-screen transfer; the preparation target remains $2M in savings.

column3: Chapter 5, Protective Custody: breakup and Mendez deal.
column4: Reported prerequisites: break up during the opening conversation in Protective Custody, maintain both Criminal Profiles at Professional and at least $500,000 in Family Savings. Accept Take Deal at the Mendez standoff.\nLucia surrenders and accepts the prosecutor deal; Jason escapes, with Rocco and money appearing in the later scenes. Keep a separate manual save before entering the finale. Sources: GTA Base and PC Gamer; not independently tested.
